cohort: Pregnant and non-pregnant women in Ha'il, Saudi Arabia, from December 15, 2021 to January 15, 2022.
finding: Covid-19 infection during pregnancy did not increase the risk of preterm birth, cesarean delivery, or low birth weight, and complete vaccination reduced the risk of hospitalization and pneumonia.
mod_finding: Covid-positive women during pregnancy underwent fewer cesarean sections than Covid negative women.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was similar between Covid-positive and Covid-negative women.
birth_weight: Mean neonatal weight at birth was similar between Covid-positive and Covid-negative women.
